scope: Read-only search for an existing Muse runtime and standard authentication metadata; no login, catalog, model turn or purchase.

catalog.prerequisite: An existing Muse CLI binary must be available before a live read-only model/list request can be attempted.

model_response.prerequisites: An appropriate existing account and explicit allowed model work; account suitability and billing were not inferred.

limits: PATH and selected standard native installation prefixes were checked; arbitrary external paths and other user accounts were not searched.
The standard Muse auth file was absent on the surveyed accounts; this does not prove that no other account or storage exists.
No claim about API pricing or a free model allowance is made.
